pill.full: {percent, number}% on the map · Analysis {number, number} · {when}
pill.shareOnly: {percent, number}% on the map · no analysis recorded
pill.running: {percent, number}% on the map · analyzing now
pill.changed: {percent, number}% on the map · {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} changed since analysis {number, number}
pill.label: Code analysis. {summary}. Press to see each analysis.

when.days: {days, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}

panel.title: Code analysis
panel.share: {mapped, number} of the {total, number} abilities found in the code are on the map ({percent, number}%).
panel.shareAll: All {total, number} abilities found in the code are on the map.
panel.counted: Counted in analysis {number, number}, {when}. Code changed after that is not counted yet.
panel.rowChange: {before, number}% → {after, number}% on the map · {added, plural, one {# concept} other {# concepts}} added, {changed, number} changed
panel.rowFirst: {after, number}% on the map · {added, plural, one {# concept} other {# concepts}} added, {changed, number} changed
panel.rowNoShare: {added, plural, one {# concept} other {# concepts}} added, {changed, number} changed
panel.earlier: {count, plural, one {# earlier analysis is} other {# earlier analyses are}} in .ontology-atlas/map-analysis.jsonl in this folder.
panel.noRecord: No analysis is recorded in this folder yet. The next time an agent adds to the map, Atlas starts the record.
panel.where: Atlas keeps this record in .ontology-atlas/map-analysis.jsonl in this folder. Git leaves that file out by default, so another copy of the folder starts its own record.
panel.unreadable: Atlas could not read .ontology-atlas/map-analysis.jsonl, so no analysis is listed. The share above comes from the project note. The next analysis adds to the file as it is.

action.mapRestHelp: Opens the map conversation, where the estimate and Start are.
action.catchUpBody: {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} to read. About {requests, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} to your agent, about {duration}.

web.analyze: Starting an analysis from Atlas needs the desktop app, which runs your coding agent. An agent you connect yourself over MCP adds to this record too.

changed.none: No file in the code changed since analysis {number, number}.
changed.some: Since analysis {number, number}, {added, plural, one {# new file} other {# new files}} and {changed, plural, one {# changed file} other {# changed files}} in the code. The share above does not count them yet.
changed.behind: {count, plural, one {# concept was} other {# concepts were}} written before the code they point at changed.
changed.unknownCommit: Atlas cannot count changed files: commit {commit}, which analysis {number, number} read, is not in this repository's history.
changed.noGit: Atlas cannot count changed files: the connected code folder is not a Git repository.
changed.web: Counting files changed since an analysis needs the desktop app, which reads the code's Git history.
